positions.title: Services Information Developer II
positions.description:
•	Working developing and maintaining the.NET web system used for the Healthcare Medicaid systems by the State.
•	Help on system wide changes for the system that affects all the subsystems of the system (fixes/changes to the core of the application).
•	Assigned to improve and add new features to the Financial and TPL subsystems of the system.
•	Coordinating with the batch team that work mostly on Unix Jobs that communicate with the DB and what is shown on the UI panels.
•	Monitoring and maintaining Production Servers when there are panels or transactions that are having a negative effect on the server performance.
•	Help on the upgrade for the different .NET version from 2.0 to now 4.5.1 framework.
•	Technologies used in the project: ASP Net, C#, Dot Net Nuke, Oracle, SQL Developer, Microsoft SQL Server, IIS, HTML, Solaris and HPUX, Visual build pro, Source Gear Vault.
•	Troubleshooting with the clients of the system.

positions.title: Software Developer Technical Lead / Developing ALM Tools
positions.description:
Technical Lead of the development team.
Coordinating tasks between the development team and also with the testing team for the tools and reports being developed. 
Point of contact between the client and the development team.
.NET Software developer. 
Development through the OTA API for HP Quality Center 10 / ALM 11 tools.
Technologies used: C#, VB. NET , Excel Interop, OpenXML and ClosedXML, IText, SQL, PL/SQL, Win Forms, WPF Mercurial HG, Quality Center / Application Lifecycle Management

positions.title: HP ALM /QC Admin
positions.description:
HP Quality center / Application Lifecycle TDAdministrator
System support and troubleshooting.
In charge of the customizations for the QC projects.
Elaborating SQL and PL/SQL queries.
Development of automated tools to facilitate the use of QC and user creation.
Maintaining Application servers (Redhat/Solaris with Apache and JBoss) and database servers (Oracle 10g and 11g)
